card.text: Explore Massalia in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Updated lightcurve reconstruction with an approximate size transferred from another published shape model. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Approximate 147 km diameter: the original thermophysical fit reports ±2 km, with additional uncertainty from using a different shape. The corrected 2026 pole and period are used; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 73.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
